    Sim
    Sim is the main class used in the Threepl simulator.
    SimArray
    A SimArray contains an array of SimValues.
    SimBits
    A SimBits is a collection of bits.
    SimBoolean
    A SimBoolean is a SimValue containing a single boolean value.
    SimBreakpoint
    A SimBreakpoint represents a simulator breakpoint.
    SimCli
    SimCli provide the command line interface to the threepl simulator.
    SimClock
    A SimClock represents a threepl clock.
    SimControl
    A SimControl is a SimValue representing a control signal.
    SimDetails
    This is a base class for SimTraceDetails and SimPlotDetails.
    SimEvent
    A SimEvent represents a scheduled event that resides in a SimEventQueue.
    SimEventQueue
    There is one SimEventQueue object.
    SimExpr
    SimExpr contains the parser for the command interface to the simulator.
    SimExprNodeValue
    A SimExprNodeValue object contains the evaluated value of a node in an expression tree, where the nodes are of type SimExprSimpleNode.
    SimExprSimpleCharStream
    An implementation of interface CharStream, where the stream is assumed to contain only ASCII characters (without unicode processing).
    SimExprSimpleNode
    A SimExprSimpleNode is a node in a SimExpr expression tree.
    SimExprToken
    Describes the input token stream.
    SimExprTokenManager
    SimExprToken Manager.
    SimFifo
    This class provides a general purpose Object queue, or fifo.
    SimFile
    SimFile handles system specific filename generation and creation.
    SimFloat
    A SimFloat is a SimNumber containing a floating point number of arbitrary mantissa and exponent precision.
    SimGroup
    A SimGroup contains a group of SimValues of possibly different types.
    SimGui
    SimGui provides the GUI interface to the threepl simulator.
    SimHelp
    This class returns help text for threepl simulator command topics.
    SimInteger
    A SimInteger is a SimNumber containing a non-floating point number.
    SimLog
    A SimLog is a SimValue containing a single boolean value.
    SimLogger
    This is a base class for SimTraceLogger and SimPlotLogger.
    SimNumber
    A SimNumber is a numeric SimValue.
    SimPlotDetails
    This class stores plot setup details.
    SimPlotLogger
    This class handles plot data storage and retrieval from a logfile, and data display in a gui.
    SimPlotWindow
    This class interacts with the SimPlotLogger class to provide a window to display a number of threepl expressions, each as a separate time series plot.
    SimPrintf
    SimPrintf is a wrapper class for the PrintfFormat class.
    SimRange
    A SimRange object contains two non-negative ints, the smaller being the low range linit and the larger being the high range limit.
    SimSample
    This class holds a sample of simulator signal values.
    SimSigned
    A SimSigned is a signed SimInteger.
    SimStruct
    A SimStruct contains a name, which is its 'type', and a number of named fields.
    SimTerminal
    This class provides a read-only text terminal emulation.
    SimTraceDetails
    This class stores trace setup details.
    SimTraceLogger
    This class handles trace data storage and retrieval from a logfile, and data display in a terminal emulation window.
    SimType  
    SimUnsigned
    A SimUnsigned is an unsigned SimInteger.
    SimValue
    A SimValue is a general purpose data storage register.
    SimVariable
    A SimVariable represents a threepl variable.
    VTextIcon
    VTextIcon is an Icon implementation which draws a short string vertically.
